product: Cribl connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Cribl connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
what_it_does: The managed Cribl connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Use the connector to ingest Cribl.Cloud Worker Group configuration, worker and health status, organization metadata, and Leader audit and access logs into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth machine to machine authentication and supports incremental ingestion for audit and access logs.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
